subject: Cross-border renewal orchestration and evidence handoff - Atlas Health PO
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@atlashealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Health Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal and EU invoice split — next steps

Kim, thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Atlas is prepared to move forward on the private-offer renewal but we need to align on two items before legal will sign: (1) we require separate invoices for the EU entity versus the US entity for VAT/accounting; (2) procurement needs an evidence bundle showing data residency in the EU and the latest SOC2 artefact.

Can you confirm Redwood can:
- Produce a two-tranche invoice (EU entity / US entity) spaced across the quarter (we can provide billing contacts and VAT IDs)
- Deliver SOC 2 Type II and a short note on where inference logs are stored (EU region), plus any certificates for the dedicated capacity pools we're contracting for

We'd like to have docs and a signed PO by next Friday 9/19 so our finance team can close the quarter.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Procurement | Atlas Health

Attachment: procurement_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@atlashealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and EU invoice split — next steps

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can do both items; looping in Priyom for billing flow and Marissa for the marketplace/private-offer paperwork. Michael, can you confirm SOC2/version and the short residency note?

Proposed next steps from our side:
1) I will draft an acceptance checklist and a proposed invoice split schedule (EU invoice on 10/01, US invoice on 11/01) — happy to adjust dates to match Atlas payroll/calendar.
2) Prio(m) will confirm VAT IDs and invoices staging (Pr: priyom).
3) Marissa will prepare the private-offer amendment and attach the signed PO stub once we have the split schedule.
4) Michael will attach SOC2 Type II and a one-page data residency summary for EU inference pools.

I'll send the consolidated bundle by EOD tomorrow so your legal team can review.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — redwood.ai

Attachment: none

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and EU invoice split — next steps

Quick note on billing mechanics:
- We can issue two invoices under separate legal entities (Redwood EU Ltd. and Redwood, Inc.). Need Atlas VAT IDs and the legal entity names — Elena, can you send those?
- We should avoid splitting acceptance windows that trigger separate marketplace acceptance checks; Marissa, can we map the private-offer acceptance to a single DocuSign PO but with two invoice lines and separate billing contacts? That keeps marketplace reconciliation simpler.
- I'll prepare a billing schedule proposal and the invoice templates for procurement to confirm.

Also tagging Marissa for any marketplace/PO constraints (AWS/GCP/Azure private-offer differences) — I remember some clouds want single-entity acceptance; if Atlas needs multi-entity invoicing we may need manual bookkeeping on our side.

Thanks,
Prio(m)
Prio(m) Das — Commercial Operations

Attachment: invoice_template_draft.xlsx (stub)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@atlashealth.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and EU invoice split — next steps

Elena — quick update from the marketplace/legal side. For the private-offer we can bundle a single acceptance/DocuSign envelope that references the private-offer amendment; the vendor acceptance recorded in the marketplace will point to the Redwood account (single acceptance). To satisfy EU VAT/invoicing, we will:
- Produce a single PO/DocuSign that David can sign, then issue two fiscal invoices (one from Redwood EU Ltd. with VAT, one from Redwood, Inc. net of VAT) per the schedule Prio suggested.
- We'll include a short attestation in the DocuSign bundle that the EU inference capacity will be pinned to EU regions (Frankfurt/Stockholm) with audit logs retained per the SLA. Michael, attaching the SOC2 and a residency note here.

Elena, can you confirm the legal signatory (David or another) and the VAT IDs by Monday 9/18? If yes, we can route the DocuSign the same day and hit your target for a signed PO on 9/19.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Marketplace Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachment: private_offer_amendment_draft.pdf (stub)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@atlashealth.com>, Atlas Health Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Sep 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and EU invoice split — next steps

Folks — final bundle attached and routing now:
- Attached: SOC2_Type2_RedwoodInference.pdf; eu-data-residency-evidence.zip (one-page residency note + region mapping); Atlas_Signed_PO_Q4.pdf (DocuSign envelope completed)
- Billing schedule: Redwood EU Ltd invoice (EUR) issued 2028-10-01 to EU billing contact; Redwood, Inc invoice (USD) issued 2028-11-01 to US billing contact. Invoice templates attached for procurement review.
- Marketplace/private-offer note: single DocuSign acceptance links the private-offer amendment to the account; finance will still receive two fiscal invoices as required.

Elena/David — please confirm you have what you need to close the renewal; if legal requires any redlines, we can process them but this should cover tax/residency concerns.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Atlas_Signed_PO_Q4.pdf, SOC2_Type2_RedwoodInference.pdf, eu-data-residency-evidence.zip
